zones._label: owner marked 2026-09-28 on photos; metres estimated. Revised the same day after his note on the DJ place ('not big ... near the metal thing ... a bit top and centre of the metal things')
zones._how: Photo 032 (= the owner's 0387927a, mean pixel difference 1.2 of 255) was taken from the crane parked at the NW end. A level-camera perspective fit of the nine visible columns of the left row (6 m pitch) gives rms 3.0 px, vanishing point u 624, horizon v 262 (from the runway girders), f*h 3821 px*m from two column bases, camera 6.88 m up (VGGT: 7.33), 1.7 m left of the nave axis, 3.8 m in front of the entry grid line (first visible column 14.2 m ahead = grid line s 18; VGGT puts the end wall 1-4 m behind the camera). Each marked pixel is put on the floor: D = f*h/(v - 262), lateral = (u - 624)*h/(v - 262). Cross-check: the ground photos 018-025, taken beside the press, sit 39-46 m from the crane camera in the VGGT cloud (the fit puts the press base 47 m out). Bay count in photo 032: the dance floor spans bays 1-5 from the crane, the stage front is at grid line 5 (s 30), the press stands at grid line 9 (s ~51-54), beside the expansion joint (paired columns, photo 021 taken there).

photo-032.note: hall frame. Fitted on the photo (level camera, horizon v 262, vanishing point u 624, f 555 px): yaw = atan((640-624)/555) to the right, and the off-centre horizon rendered as a 10 deg pitch down — the photo itself is level with its principal point off-centre, so a render's verticals converge slightly where the photo's do not.
